about: Authored output-schema envelope cases replayed by both implementations. Each case states an authored schema, whether the object-rooted envelope wraps it, and the exact bytes the wire shaping must emit. The expected values are written by hand from the specification, never captured from a run: a corpus generated from one implementation records that implementation's beliefs, and the point of this file is to catch the two disagreeing. The Platform suite asserts this file is byte-identical in both trees.

cases.name: an-array-root-is-wrapped-in-the-golden-envelope
cases.why: The committed golden for the common case: a non-object root is wrapped once, in one shape, everywhere.

cases.name: an-object-root-is-carried-byte-for-byte
cases.why: An object root is carried byte for byte, member order included; the envelope never adds a member it was not asked for.

cases.name: an-object-null-root-collapses-to-object
cases.why: A root declared object-or-null is normalized to object: the envelope carries optional objects without wrapping them.

cases.name: an-object-union-with-another-type-is-wrapped-not-collapsed
cases.why: An object union with a third type is a wrapped root, not a collapsed one; the authored type array survives untouched.

cases.name: a-root-reference-is-rebased-into-the-envelope
cases.why: A whole-schema reference to the document root is rebased to the synthetic result member.

cases.name: defs-and-dynamic-refs-are-rebased
cases.why: Definitions travel inside the envelope with their internal dynamic references rebased to match.

cases.name: if-then-else-references-are-rebased
cases.why: Applicability clauses hold schemas exactly like any other position; their references are rebased with the rest.

cases.name: dependentschemas-references-are-rebased
cases.why: dependentSchemas maps property names to schemas; the values are schema positions and their references are rebased.

cases.name: unevaluated-and-naming-positions-are-rebased
cases.why: The unevaluated- and naming- positions are schema positions in draft 2020-12 and are rebased like any other.

cases.name: data-positions-are-never-rebased
cases.why: const, enum, examples and default are data the schema compares against, not positions a resolver walks; a reference-shaped value there must survive byte for byte, nested keyword names included.

cases.name: anchor-and-external-references-are-preserved
cases.why: Anchor references and external references never resolve inside the envelope and are left exactly as authored.

cases.name: legacy-tuple-items-are-rebased
cases.why: The legacy draft-07 tuple form of items lists one schema per position; both forms are rebased so neither dangles.

cases.name: legacy-positions-are-rebased
cases.why: Legacy positions — definitions, additionalItems, contains, not, contentSchema — are schema positions and are rebased.

cases.name: prefix-and-composition-lists-are-rebased
cases.why: Composition lists hold schemas element-wise; every element's references are rebased.

cases.name: a-malformed-type-array-is-preserved-inside-the-envelope
cases.why: A malformed type array fails closed into the envelope with its bytes preserved; nothing is interpreted, only wrapped.

cases.name: boolean-subschemas-are-leaves
cases.why: Boolean subschemas are leaves: the traversal reaches them and rewrites nothing.
